propositions: Five pre-1.0 CLI alias commands (bridge-status, bridge-fsck, bridge-probe, jira-onboard, verify-authorship) must be removed from the registry and made invalid at parse time with exit code 2
Canonical command spellings (bridge status, bridge fsck, bridge check-access, bridge setup, verify-identity) must preserve their current owners and exit behaviors after alias removal
All CLI help, reference, and documentation generation scripts must be regenerated to omit removed aliases
Test suites must be updated to replace alias-success tests with invalid-choice parse-rejection tests and retarget subprocess invocations to canonical commands
Maintained operational prose and remediation text must use canonical commands instead of removed aliases, while historical release notes and ADRs preserve old spellings as historical evidence
reconcile and reconcile-check commands are explicitly excluded from this migration
